learning_outcomes.text: Capacity to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Capacity for handling specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Capacity to apply quality principles and methods.

syllabus_topics: Terminology, standards and maintenance control ratios
teaching_methods: Readings of documentation, videos and answers to simple questions
Resolution of exercises, problems, cases (Practical cases)
assessment_rules: The general evaluation model is continuous assessment, requiring a global grade of 5.0 or higher. A minimum grade of 5 is required for the Final Written Exam, Test Block I, and Test Block III. Attendance is mandatory for practices and seminars. Students failing the ordinary call can retake only the unpassed re-evaluable activities in the extraordinary call.
